standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the normalization step of the sequence over the completion back to the original ring, giving finiteness of the normalization.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of blowing up in a closed point and identification of the special fibres
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, the compatibility of blowing up with flat base change, and the isomorphism of the closed fibres of the members of the sequence with those of their base changes
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the blowing up over the completion is the base change of the blowing up of the corresponding closed point over the original ring.

core_obligations: Set up the induction (proof lines 3239-3252): given the sequence of normalized blowups over the completion, construct the sequence over the original ring inductively; the base case is the identity on the spectrum of the base; suppose the i-th member has the given base change.

Run the induction step (proof lines 3252-3262): the closed fibre of the i-th member is isomorphic to that of its base change, so the closed point blown up over the completion corresponds to a closed point on the special fibre of the original member; blowing up that point produces a scheme whose base change is the blowing up appearing over the completion, and the normalization step descends because normalization commutes with completion for the local domain, giving finiteness and the required base change.
proof_roadmap: Inductively construct the members of the sequence over the original ring.
Match the closed points blown up through the isomorphism of the closed fibres.
Descend the normalization step using compatibility of normalization with completion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Noetherian local domain with normal completion, every sequence of normalized blowups over the completion is the base change of a sequence of proper normalized blowups over the original ring (statement lines 3235-3243). The proof (proof lines 3244-3262) is an induction matching the closed points blown up through the isomorphism of the closed fibres and descending the normalization step. H2: a complete induction.
